body: You can't spot reduce your face any more than you can spot reduce your belly. I didn't do a single face exercise. When the fat came off my belly, it came off my face too. Getting lean is by far the most powerful way to looksmax your face. In this video, I'm showing you my own comparison and exactly what changed when I lost the fat. My face looks better now, and I have a defined jawline where there wasn't one before.

Your face is the first thing people see. It's the first thing she sees on a dating app. I partially agree with Clavicular that men neglect their face, because I did that myself. I didn't start a skincare routine or getting my eyebrows done until a few years ago. But your body and building muscle matter too.
